ideas.pitch: Real-time augmented reality visualizer for orbital space junk tracking using NASA open telemetry APIs.
ideas.title: AstroDebris-AR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with NASA's core space exploration and education mission while delivering a highly visual demo that works live, following the proven winner pattern.

ideas.pitch: Poisson regression and spatial forecasting model predicting exoplanet atmospheric volatility using NASA Kepler mission datasets.
ideas.title: ExoClimate-GAM
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard statistical engineering with calibrated prediction intervals, matching the winning strategy of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: Satellite-based computer vision platform monitoring urban heat island expansion over New York City using Landsat open data.
ideas.title: EarthWatch-Atlas
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven satellite monitoring tech to local NYC geography, making the pitch immediately relevant to local judges and space apps themes.

ideas.pitch: LightGBM-powered classification and alert platform for predicting geomagnetic storms impacting terrestrial power grids.
ideas.title: SolarFlare-Predict
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses high-performance tree models with explainable feature attribution, mirroring the winning approach of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: Interactive web simulation balancing life support resources for a Martian habitat using real NASA life support telemetry constraints.
ideas.title: MarsHab-Sim
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines gamified science communication with a fully functional live web app demo that NASA judges can interact with directly.
